name: Miyuki
source: One of the popular girls at school with a beautiful voice. She's a regular at Tea Masters and despite her popularity, she's always there alone for some reason. Miyuki has a will of steel and once she's set a goal for herself there is nothing that can hold her back. She dreams of the day when she'll be recognized for her talent.
